title: Israeli bank lets customers buy Bitcoin but charges them 2% to get in and 2% to get out
summary:
The app blocks transfers to outside wallets and institutions and charges 2% on each buy or sell.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: An Israeli bank is allowing its customers to buy Bitcoin through its application. However, the service comes with restrictions and high fees, including a two percent charge for both buying and selling. Additionally, the platform blocks transfers to outside digital wallets and financial institutions, limiting how users can manage their cryptocurrency holdings.
content_ta: இஸ்ரேலைச் சேர்ந்த ஒரு வங்கி தனது வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் தங்கள் ஆப் மூலம் Bitcoin வாங்க அனுமதிக்கிறது. இருப்பினும், வாங்குவதற்கும் விற்பனை செய்வதற்கும் தலா இரண்டு சதவீதம் கட்டணம் வசூலிக்கப்படுகிறது. மேலும், இந்த தளம் வெளி டிஜிட்டல் வாலட்கள் மற்றும் நிதி நிறுவனங்களுக்கு பணம் அனுப்புவதை blok செய்கிறது, இதனால் பயனர்கள் தங்கள் கிரிப்டோகரன்சியை நிர்வகிப்பதில் சில கட்டுப்பாடுகள் உள்ளன.

title: ‘Not your Silicon, not your keys’ — Ethereum’s Buterin calls for open-source chip design
summary: Why does he think hardware security is a growing concern for crypto users?
content: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has emphasized the need for open-source hardware and chip design in the cryptocurrency space. Highlighting growing security concerns for users, Buterin advocated for transparency in physical hardware similar to software security principles. This push addresses potential vulnerabilities in proprietary microchips used across the industry.
content_ta: Ethereum-ன் இணை நிறுவனரான Vitalik Buterin, கிரிப்டோகரன்சி துறையில் ஓபன்-சோர்ஸ் ஹார்டுவேர் மற்றும் சிப் வடிவமைப்பு அவசியத்தை வலியுறுத்தியுள்ளார். பயனர்களின் பாதுகாப்பு கவலைகளைச் சுட்டிக்காட்டிய அவர், மென்பொருள் பாதுகாப்பு கொள்கைகளைப் போலவே இயற்பியல் ஹார்டுவேரிலும் வெளிப்படைத்தன்மை இருக்க வேண்டும் என்று வாதிட்டார்.

content_ta: Bullish நிறுவனம் தனது ஈக்விட்டி டோக்கனைசேஷன் சேவைகளை Aptos மற்றும் Ethereum பிளாக்செயின் நெட்வொர்க்குகளுக்கு விரிவுபடுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த பல சங்கிலி விரிவாக்கம், பாரம்பரிய சொத்துக்களை பரவலாக்கப்பட்ட தளங்களுக்கு கொண்டு வருவதன் மூலம் வர்த்தக திறனையும் நெகிழ்வுத்தன்மையையும் மேம்படுத்துவதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது. நவீன நிதிச் சந்தைகளில் பிளாக்செயின் தொழில்நுட்பத்தின் ஒருங்கிணைப்பு அதிகரித்து வருவதை இந்த வளர்ச்சி எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

title: CryptoStar USA shuts down its last Bitcoin miners in Utah

content: CryptoStar USA has officially shut down its remaining Bitcoin miners in Utah. The decision underscores the growing industry-wide trend of adapting to shifting market demands and regulatory pressures within the technology sector.
content_ta: CryptoStar USA நிறுவனம் Utah-வில் தனது கடைசி Bitcoin மைனிங் பணிகளை அதிகாரப்பூர்வமாக நிறுத்தியுள்ளது. கிரிப்டோகரன்சி மைனிங் துறையிலிருந்து விலகி, செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு (AI) ஹோஸ்டிங் சேவைக்கு மாறுவதை இந்த முடிவு காட்டுகிறது. மாறிவரும் சந்தை தேவைகள் மற்றும் ஒழுங்குமுறை சவால்களுக்கு ஏற்ப தொழில்நுட்ப நிறுவனங்கள் தம்மை மாற்றிக்கொள்ளும் போக்கினை இது விளக்குகிறது.

title: Meta Oversight Board study finds AI chatbots mirror government speech limits
summary:
AI chatbots' alignment with restrictive speech laws globally could undermine free expression, leading to censorship by proxy across borders.
The post Meta Oversight Board study finds AI chatbots mirror government speech limits appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A new study by the Meta Oversight Board reveals that AI chatbots often mirror government speech limits. According to the findings, this alignment with restrictive speech laws globally could undermine free expression and result in censorship by proxy across borders.
content_ta: Meta Oversight Board நடத்திய புதிய ஆய்வில், AI சாட்போட்டுகள் பல சமயங்களில் அரசாங்கத்தின் பேச்சு வரம்புகளைப் பிரதிபலிப்பது கண்டறியப்பட்டுள்ளது. உலகளவில் உள்ள கட்டுப்பாடான பேச்சுரிமைச் சட்டங்களுடன் இந்த சீரமைப்பு ஏற்படுவது கருத்துச் சுதந்திரத்தைக் குலைத்து, எல்லைகளைத் தாண்டிய மறைமுக தணிக்கைக்கு வழிவகுக்கும் என்று அந்த முடிவுகள் தெரிவிக்கின்றன.

title: Amazon’s AI business is growing 440x faster than early AWS, says Jassy

title: PayPal’s PYUSD stablecoin goes live on Sei with sub-second settlement

content: PayPal’s PYUSD stablecoin has officially launched on the Sei blockchain, offering users sub-second transaction settlement times. title: Microsoft paper finds coding agents beat dedicated prompt optimizers at tuning other agents
summary:
Microsoft's CASD method could democratize AI optimization by reducing costs and infrastructure needs, benefiting smaller teams significantly.
The post Microsoft paper finds coding agents beat dedicated prompt optimizers at tuning other agents appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A recent Microsoft paper reveals that coding agents outperform dedicated prompt optimizers in tuning other AI agents. This method, known as CASD, has the potential to democratize artificial intelligence optimization by significantly reducing infrastructure and cost requirements. Such advancements could provide a major benefit for smaller teams and developers looking to deploy efficient AI systems without needing massive computational resources.
content_ta: Microsoft வெளியிட்ட புதிய ஆய்வறிக்கையின்படி, மற்ற AI ஏஜென்ட்களை மேம்படுத்துவதில் பிரத்யேக ப்ராம்ட் ஆப்டிமைசர்களை விட கோடிங் ஏஜென்ட்கள் சிறப்பாகச் செயல்படுகின்றன. CASD என அழைக்கப்படும் இந்த முறை, உள்கட்டமைப்பு மற்றும் செலவினங்களைக் குறைப்பதன் மூலம் AI மேம்பாட்டை அனைவருக்கும் எளிதாக்கும் திறனைக் கொண்டுள்ளது. இந்த முன்னேற்றங்கள் சிறிய குழுக்களுக்கு மிகவும் பயனுள்ளதாக இருக்கும்.

content: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy has projected that Amazon Web Services (AWS) could eventually exceed $1 trillion in annual revenue. title: Solana faces its ‘worst’ year since launch as November losses hit 22%
summary: Solana longs are piling up, but is strong DEX activity enough to beat the bearish trend?
content: Solana is experiencing a difficult period, recording significant losses in November that add to a challenging year since its launch. Despite a bearish market trend and mounting losses, investors continue to hold long positions, while decentralized exchange (DEX) activity remains a point of interest for the network's future direction.
content_ta: Solana ஒரு கடிமான காலகட்டத்தை எதிர்கொண்டு வருகிறது. நவம்பர் மாதத்தில் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க சரிவைச் சந்தித்துள்ள இந்த கிரிப்டோகரன்சி, அதன் தொடக்கத்திற்குப் பிறகு மிகவும் மோசமான ஆண்டைக் கண்டுள்ளது. கரடி சந்தைப் போக்கு மற்றும் தொடரும் இழப்புகளுக்கு மத்தியில், முதலீட்டாளர்கள் தொடர்ந்து லாங் பொசிஷன்களை வைத்துள்ளனர். அதே நேரத்தில், DEX செயல்பாடுகள் இந்த நெட்வொர்க்கின் எதிர்கால திசைக்கு முக்கியப் புள்ளியாக உள்ளன.

title: Solana News: Developers Issue Urgent Upgrade Notice to Mainnet Validators
summary: Key takeaways Anza told Solana mainnet operators, staked and unstaked, to install Agave validator client v4.4.2 immediately. The developers said the network was continuing to operate normally; the release does not by itself indicate an outage, exploit or attack. The exact technical issue behind the urgent release has not been fully established. Validator directory data shows mixed software versions, but no verified breakdown of v4.4.2 adoption is available yet. The notice is aimed at node operators, not wallet holders, and does not by itself require SOL users to take any action. Solana developers have issued an urgent instruction to network operators, asking them to install the latest version of the Agave validator client without delay. The announcement from Anza, the development team responsible for maintaining Agave, applies to both staked and unstaked nodes running the affected software. The developers also indicated that the network was continuing to operate normally. The announcement follows a series of Solana validator software improvements introduced earlier this month, including further development of Agave and Firedancer. An urgent software update does not necessarily mean that a blockchain is experiencing an outage. In Solana’s case, the more interesting question is how quickly its distributed network of operators can respond when developers identify a problem that cannot wait for a routine upgrade. What Is Behind Solana’s Urgent Upgrade? Anza directed operators to install version 4.4.2 of its validator software, telling them in its announcement: “ Don’t wait, upgrade now. Anza · Agave v4.4.2 upgrade notice The release is documented in Anza’s official GitHub repository, while compatible builds have also reportedly been made available by Jito-Solana and Harmonic. Agave is one of the software implementations responsible for processing transactions and participating in Solana’s consensus mechanism. Validators running it help determine which transactions become part of the blockchain. Unlike updating an application on a phone, updating validator software involves coordinating machines operated by independent organizations around the world. Developers can release a new version, but the operators themselves must deploy it. Network monitoring data from Validator Info shows that both Agave 4.4.2 and Jito 4.4.2-jito have been released, while Firedancer’s latest listed version is 26.11.1. The availability of these releases does not, however, establish how many validators have installed them. That makes the speed of adoption almost as interesting as the release itself. A check of the Solana validator directory shows operators reporting different software versions, including Agave-derived implementations. However, a complete and independently verified breakdown of the latest upgrade’s adoption was not yet available. The precise technical issue behind Anza’s urgent instruction remains to be fully established. Describing the release as a response to an exploit or an active network attack would therefore be premature. Solana’s Recent Upgrades Face a Different Kind of Test The announcement comes just weeks after Solana introduced significant changes to its underlying infrastructure. As NewsBTC previously reported, the Solana Foundation introduced protocol version 1.0 in November and moved away from describing the network as mainnet beta. The distinction between the protocol version and the validator software version is important. Solana can establish a common set of network rules while individual software implementations continue to receive updates and fixes. The network has also been pursuing faster transaction processing and shorter confirmation times through its Alpenglow consensus architecture. Those improvements are valuable, but faster transactions are only useful if the infrastructure processing them remains dependable. What Does the Upgrade Mean for SOL Holders? For ordinary users, Anza’s instruction is aimed at node operators rather than wallet holders. The announcement does not, by itself, establish a need for users to move their SOL or change how they interact with the network. At the time of the dashboard snapshot, Solana had 655 active validators and five listed as delinquent. Approximately 423.44 million SOL was actively staked, representing 99.97% of the reported total stake. The figures offer a snapshot of network participation while operators are being asked to update their software, although they do not independently confirm the success of the upgrade. The next meaningful development will be evidence that operators have installed the new release and that transaction processing remains stable throughout the rollout. Solana has spent considerable time demonstrating how fast its network can become. This weekend’s upgrade offers another opportunity to assess something equally important: how well its infrastructure responds when speed is required outside of normal transaction processing.
content: Solana developers have issued an urgent upgrade notice to mainnet validators, instructing node operators to install the Agave validator client version 4.4.2 immediately. The network continues to operate normally, and developers clarified that the release does not necessarily indicate an outage or attack. The exact technical issue has not been fully established, and regular SOL holders are not required to take any action.
content_ta: Solana டெவலப்பர்கள் மெயின்நெட் வேலிடேட்டர்களுக்கு ஒரு அவசர மேம்படுத்தல் அறிவிப்பை வெளியிட்டுள்ளனர், Agave வேலிடேட்டர் கிளைன்ட் பதிப்பு 4.4.2-ஐ உடனடியாக நிறுவுமாறு நோடு ஆபரேட்டர்களை அறிவுறுத்தியுள்ளனர். நெட்வொர்க் சாதாரணமாக இயங்கி வருகிறது, மேலும் இந்த வெளியீடு அவுட்டேஜ் அல்லது தாக்குதலைக் குறிக்கவில்லை என்று டெவலப்பர்கள் தெளிவுபடுத்தினர். துல்லியமான தொழில்நுட்ப சிக்கல் முழுமையாக கண்டறியப்படவில்லை, மேலும் வழக்கமான SOL வைத்திருப்பவர்கள் எந்த நடவடிக்கையும் எடுக்கத் தேவையில்லை.

title: Trump Crypto News: World Liberty Financial Sells $20 Million in Ethereum Assets, Data Shows
summary: Key takeaways A wallet linked to World Liberty Financial sold 10,600 WETH and 1,378 mETH for about $20.06 million. Proceeds went into about $17.58 million USDC and $2.48 million USD1, the project’s own stablecoin. On-chain analyst Ember estimates a cost of $3,244 per ETH against a disposal value near $1,655, implying a loss of about $19.26 million. The loss is an on-chain estimate, not an audited figure, and the sale covers one wallet rather than the project’s full holdings. The move reverses earlier Ethereum buying, and there is no verified evidence that Donald Trump personally directed the trades. Trump-backed crypto project World Liberty Financial has reportedly reduced its Ethereum exposure by approximately $20 million, converting two large holdings into dollar-pegged stablecoins during the latest cryptocurrency market downturn. Blockchain monitoring platform Lookonchain reported that a wallet associated with the project sold 10,600 ETH and 1,378 mETH, receiving approximately $20.06 million. Separate estimates from on-chain analyst Ember suggest the assets may have been sold at a loss of more than $19 million. The transactions come just weeks after World Liberty Financial announced a WLFI token buyback program, which could be partly funded by income generated from its USD1 stablecoin reserves. The Ethereum sales represent a notable reversal for a project that previously accumulated the cryptocurrency during periods of market weakness. Where the money went, however, deserves just as much attention as what was sold. World Liberty Financial Moves Into Stablecoins The reported transactions involved approximately $17.58 million in USDC and another $2.48 million in USD1, World Liberty Financial’s own dollar-pegged stablecoin. Transaction records from Arkham show a series of transfers between World Liberty Financial’s labeled Strategic Reserve wallet and CoW Protocol, involving outgoing mETH and incoming USD1. The wallet also interacted with decentralized lending protocol Dolomite. The Ethereum assets included wrapped ether, known as WETH, and mETH, a token representing exposure to staked Ethereum. The latter distinction matters because a liquid staking token does not necessarily trade at a one-to-one ratio with ETH. Simply adding the number of WETH and mETH tokens together can give a misleading picture of the underlying Ethereum exposure. According to Ember’s estimates, the combined holdings represented approximately 12,121 ETH in equivalent exposure. The analyst estimated an average acquisition cost of $3,244 per ETH, compared with an average disposal value of approximately $1,655. If that cost-basis estimate is accurate, the transactions would represent a loss of roughly $19.26 million, or close to half the original investment. Transaction Reported figure Sold 10,600 WETH + 1,378 mETH Ethereum-equivalent exposure ≈12,121 ETH Received $17.58M USDC + $2.48M USD1 = $20.06M Estimated average cost $3,244 per ETH (≈$39.3M) Average disposal value ≈$1,655 per ETH Estimated loss ≈$19.26M (about 49%) World Liberty Financial’s reported Ethereum sale. Cost basis and loss are on-chain estimates, not audited results. Data: Lookonchain, Ember. Visualization: NewsBTC. World Liberty Financial has not been shown to have confirmed that loss in a public accounting statement. The figure remains an on-chain estimate rather than an audited financial result. Why the USD1 Transaction Matters World Liberty Financial’s decision to move part of the reported proceeds into USD1 raises questions beyond the performance of its Ethereum investments. In its official USD1 risk disclosures, World Liberty Financial acknowledges that its financial interests and those of BitGo may differ from those of USD1 holders. Both benefit from net fees earned through interest on the stablecoin’s reserves, while USD1 holders are not entitled to those earnings. That makes USD1 more than another cryptocurrency held in the project’s treasury. It is part of the business through which World Liberty Financial seeks to generate revenue from its digital-dollar product. Holding USD1, however, does not automatically generate a return for the wallet that receives it. Nor does an exchange of existing tokens necessarily increase the stablecoin’s circulating supply or reserve income. The relevant question is whether the transactions represent temporary treasury management or a broader change in the project’s investment strategy. A Reversal of Its Earlier Ethereum Strategy In January, NewsBTC reported that World Liberty Financial had acquired approximately 2,868 ETH after selling more than $8 million worth of wrapped Bitcoin. The November transactions point in the opposite direction, with the reported wallet moving away from Ethereum-linked exposure and toward dollar-denominated assets. It would nevertheless be misleading to conclude that World Liberty Financial has abandoned Ethereum entirely. The activity concerns a specific wallet, and the project’s broader holdings across other addresses have not been established by these transactions. Data from Arkham Intelligence shows that the project’s labeled Strategic Reserve wallet held approximately $243.8 million in digital assets on November 28. Notably, more than 96% of that valuation came from its own WLFI token, while the wallet retained 2,000 ETH worth approximately $3.32 million. The concentration raises a separate question about the reserve’s exposure to fluctuations in the price of its own token. Its reported portfolio value should not necessarily be confused with readily available liquidity. There is also no verified evidence that President Donald Trump personally instructed the trades. For Ethereum investors, the reported sale is another example of a large crypto-linked entity reducing exposure during a difficult market. For World Liberty Financial’s stakeholders, the more consequential questions concern its treasury strategy, the management of investment losses and the transparency of its financial disclosures. The blockchain can reveal how assets moved. It cannot, on its own, explain who authorized those movements or why.
